description_zh: 从河西走廊到西域都护府，汉帝国的世界探索。
description_en: From the Hexi Corridor to the Western Regions, the Han Empire's world exploration.

narrative_intro.text_zh: 起初，西汉的疆域被局限在玉门关以东。为了联合大月氏夹击匈奴，[张骞](zhang_qian_west_-138)踏上了九死一生的西行之路。虽然军事同盟未能达成，但他带回了西域的广阔情报。随后，汉武帝发动了[河西之战](emperor_wu_expansion_-121)，打通了通往西方的咽喉。从[丝绸之路](silk_road_growth_-119)开始，东方的丝绸与西方的汗血宝马开始了数千年的交换。
narrative_intro.text_en: Initially, the Western Han was confined east of the Yumen Pass. To form an alliance with the Yuezhi against the Xiongnu, [Zhang Qian](zhang_qian_west_-138) embarked on a perilous journey west. Although the military alliance failed, he brought back vast intelligence about the Western Regions. Later, Emperor Wu launched the [Hexi Campaign](emperor_wu_expansion_-121), opening the throat to the West. With the [Silk Road](silk_road_growth_-119), the exchange of Eastern silk for Western Ferghana horses began a millennia-long trade.
narrative_intro.core_question_zh: 如果没有战争的迫切需求，丝绸之路还会被开拓吗？
narrative_intro.core_question_en: Without the urgent need for war, would the Silk Road still have been opened?

description_zh: 从黄巾起义到三家归晋，英雄辈出的乱世。
description_en: From the Yellow Turban Rebellion to the Jin unification, an era of heroes and chaos.

narrative_intro.text_zh:
随着[黄巾起义](yellow_turban_184)的爆发，庞大的东汉帝国开始走向解体。群雄逐鹿中，[汉朝灭亡](han_end_220)，[曹魏](wei_founding_220)在北方率先建立政权。为了延续汉室正统，刘备在西南建立了[蜀汉](shu_founding_221)；而孙权则在江东巩固了[东吴](wu_founding_229)的统治。这三家形成了鼎立之势。

为了打破僵局，诸葛亮发动了[北伐](zhuge_northern_campaign_228)，试图以攻为守。然而，国力的悬殊最终让[蜀汉走向灭亡](shu_fall_263)，三国鼎立的平衡被打破，天下终将再次一统。
narrative_intro.text_en:
With the outbreak of the [Yellow Turban Rebellion](yellow_turban_184), the massive Eastern Han Empire began to collapse. Amidst warlord conflicts, the [Han Dynasty ended](han_end_220), and [Cao Wei](wei_founding_220) established its regime in the north. To continue the Han lineage, Liu Bei founded [Shu Han](shu_founding_221) in the southwest, while Sun Quan consolidated [Eastern Wu](wu_founding_229) in the southeast, forming a tripartite balance.

To break the stalemate, Zhuge Liang launched the [Northern Campaigns](zhuge_northern_campaign_228). However, the disparity in national strength eventually led to the [fall of Shu Han](shu_fall_263), breaking the balance and paving the way for eventual reunification.
narrative_intro.core_question_zh: 在绝对的实力差距面前，个人的努力能改变历史的走向吗？
narrative_intro.core_question_en: In the face of absolute disparity in strength, can individual effort change the course of history?
